matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: EfficientDet introduces a Bidirectional Feature Pyramid Network (BiFPN) with weighted feature fusion to combine multi-scale features more effectively than top-down-only pyramids.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: The weighted bi-directional feature pyramid network allows easy and fast multi-scale feature fusion.

matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: A compound scaling rule jointly scales backbone depth, BiFPN width and depth, and input resolution rather than scaling a single dimension in isolation.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: The compound scaling method uniformly scales resolution, depth, and width for all networks.

matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: EfficientDet-D7 achieves around 55 AP on COCO with significantly fewer FLOPs and parameters than prior detectors at similar accuracy levels.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: EfficientDet-D7 achieves state-of-the-art 55.1 AP on COCO test-dev.

matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: Scaling only network depth, only width, or only input resolution leads to a suboptimal accuracy-efficiency tradeoff compared to compound multi-dimension scaling.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: The compound scaling method achieves better efficiency than single-dimension scaling methods.

unmatched_a.a_claim_text_normalized: EfficientDet trades raw GPU latency for parameter and FLOP efficiency, which can disadvantage it on hardware tuned for high-throughput inference of larger but simpler architectures.
